"""Small public smoke checks; this is not the hidden verifier."""
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
data = (root / "examples/requests.jsonl").read_bytes()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(root / "submission/main.py")], input=data,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=90)
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
assert len(rows) == 4
assert rows[0]["hosts"] == [{"sent":0,"received":[[4]]},{"sent":0,"received":[[4]]}]
assert rows[0]["floor"] == 1 and rows[0]["slots"] == []
assert rows[1] == {"safe":True,"safety":None,"terminates":True,"liveness":None}
assert rows[2]["safe"] and not rows[2]["terminates"]
assert rows[3] == {"safe":False,"safety":{"prefix":[]},"terminates":True,"liveness":None}
print("Public examples passed.")
